Assistant reported commits ebd7732 and e0e0fb3 pushed, branch 0/0 ahead/behind upstream, and ad-hoc mocked exercise of all code paths plus gx lint clean.
analysis.notes: No formal test suite exists for GitHub-side behavior; the only 'test' run was an ad-hoc mocked exercise of the module plus gx lint/openspec validate/node --check, so session_class edit+tests is borderline. The file path 'script/enableAutoMerge.js' in turn 4 is the user's wording but reflects a name chosen by the original model; a replay may choose a different folder/filename, so c3 and c5 should be judged against whatever file the replay created. Turns 1 and 3 were no-ops in the original because the model had already pushed.
